intent: Each jump has a 1-in-30 chance to set off a short-lived explosion where the jumper took off. Anyone caught in its small radius (jumper included) is blasted away and slammed downward, losing height; a visible fireball and shake make it readable.
accept: Some jumps (roughly 1 in 30) produce a visible explosion at the take-off point; most do not
A player inside the blast radius is thrown sideways and downward, and a player outside is unaffected
The explosion looks the same regardless of who jumped
A test forces the chance roll and checks the blast hits only players in range

criteria.text: Some jumps (roughly 1 in 30) produce a visible explosion at the take-off point; most do not
criteria.evidence: rules.ts movePlayer spawns a blast on randomInt(blastOdds)===0 at p.x,p.y; test 'about 1 in blastOdds jumps explodes' checks the rate; assets.ts drawBlast draws a 70px orange fireball + ring + particles. Not seen in after shots (all 3 identical to before; random and rare).

criteria.text: A player inside the blast radius is thrown sideways and downward, and a player outside is unaffected
criteria.evidence: applyBlasts sets kick and vy=blastSlam for players within r; test asserts jumper and close player slammed/kicked, far player vy 0, kick 0, still on ground.

criteria.text: The explosion looks the same regardless of who jumped
criteria.evidence: drawBlast ignores the owner; blast entity carries no player data, only ticksLeft/fresh.

criteria.text: A test forces the chance roll and checks the blast hits only players in range
criteria.evidence: rules.test.ts 'jump blasts' uses hitSeed() to find a seed with a blast, then checks near vs far players.

findings: Caveat: the preview clip (after shot-1..3) shows no blast, so a viewer comparing clips may see no difference. This is inherent to the 1-in-30 spec; consider only that the effect is large when it fires. Optionally make the preview scenario show jumping players.
